title: Self-Programmed Execution for Language-Model Agents
abstract: arXiv:2605.06898v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: At the heart of a language model agent is an orchestrator program which is responsible for the state transition between consecutive turns. In existing systems, this program is implemented in the harness. This paper introduces self-programmed execution (SPE), in which the model completion is itself the orchestrator program, and the harness evaluates this program but does not impose any fixed orchestration policy. Formally, an SPE state of an agentic machine is one from which a model completion can load any successor state up to an embedding, and an instance of an SPE state is one which executes the model completion as a program. In practice, the program requires a language with unusual features, as its source code doubles as the content of the model's context window. translated_title: 面向语言模型智能体的自编程执行
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体的核心是一个编排器程序，它负责相邻两轮对话之间的状态转换。在现有系统中，该程序是在框架中实现的。本文提出了自编程执行（SPE），即模型生成的补全本身就是编排器程序，而框架仅负责评估该程序，不施加任何固定的编排策略。在形式上，智能体机器的SPE状态是指从该状态出发，模型补全能够在嵌入意义下加载任意后继状态；而SPE状态的实例则是指将模型补全作为程序来执行的状态。在实践中，该程序需要一种具有特殊特性的语言，因为其源代码同时充当模型上下文窗口的内容。因此，我引入了Spell，这是一种Lisp方言，其中的程序可以编辑并重新求值自身，而具有效果的语句（如模型调用）的结构设计使得（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出自编程执行（SPE），让模型补全本身充当驱动智能体状态转换的编排器程序，并为此设计了可自我编辑与重新求值的Lisp方言Spell。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Self-Programmed Execution (SPE), where the model's completion itself serves as the orchestrator program driving agent state transitions, and introduces Spell, a Lisp dialect whose programs can edit and re-evaluate themselves.
